On the table there is only one small plate with a single fried egg and that one bowl and pair of chopsticks — a spare, lonely setting. Preserve his appearance, his deep navy tee, the plain wall behind, the dark doorway, the side window with flat grey light, the empty chair at the left edge, and the exact placement of the plate, bowl, and chopsticks. The camera holds an almost static shot with only a faint drift. From this position he lowers his gaze to the lone fried egg and gently brings the chopsticks a little lower toward the plate, then stops and holds completely still without eating, the chopsticks hovering just above the egg. His face stays quiet and blank; he does not move for the rest of the shot as the emptiness of the table settles around him. Clean frame with no subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no Chinese characters and no watermark anywhere in the frame.
